description: Generate one image from a text prompt with gpt-image-2.5-sunburst or gpt-image-2.5-flare on the ChatGPT subscription backend (a Codex chat model hosts the image_generation tool). Returns viewable content blocks (image + caption) that render inline, and saves the file under data/provider-openai-codex/images/ (details.path) for other processes to pick up.

background.description: `transparent`, `opaque`, or `auto`; transparency needs png or webp.

file_name.description: File stem for the persisted image (letters, digits, `.`, `_`, `-`; anything else becomes `-`). A timestamp and a random suffix are always appended so files never collide. Defaults to `image`.

host_model.description: Codex chat model that hosts the `image_generation` tool call (default `gpt-5.5`; the router's `codex/` prefix is accepted).

inline.description: Whether the result embeds image bytes: `none` (default — the file is saved, `details.path` names it, and the console fetches its own preview), `preview` (a JPEG at most 512px / ~80 KB, for an agent that must look at the picture; fits the harness result cap), or `full` (the original bytes — over a megabyte for a 1024px PNG).

output_format.description: `png` (default), `jpeg`, or `webp`: the format of the file saved under data/ (and of the inline picture when `inline` is `full`).

quality.description: `low`, `medium`, `high`, or `auto`; the model default when omitted.

size.description: `1024x1024`, `1536x1024` (landscape), `1024x1536` (portrait), or `auto`; the model default when omitted.

ContentBlock.description: One block of a viewable response: an image block plus a text line — the shape the harness renders inline (same as `browser::screenshot`).

height.description: Pixel height of the saved file, when decodable.

host_model.description: Codex chat model that hosted the tool call.

inline.description: `preview`, `full`, or `none`: what the inline image block carries.

mime.description: Mime of the saved file: `image/png`, `image/jpeg`, or `image/webp`.

model.description: Image model that produced the picture.

path.description: Absolute path of the full-resolution file under `data/provider-openai-codex/images/`.

preview.description: Present when `inline` is `preview` and the preview could be built.

quality.description: Requested quality (`auto` when left to the model).

revised_prompt.description: The prompt as the model actually rendered it, when upstream reports one.

size.description: Requested size (`auto` when left to the model).

width.description: Pixel width of the saved file, when decodable.

ImageUsage.description: Token usage of the hosting Responses call (absent when the backend omits it).

PreviewDetails.description: What the inline image block actually holds when it is a preview.

content.description: `[image block, text line]` (`[text line]` with `inline: none`) — render `content` and the picture shows.
